findings.title: 4 innerHTML/outerHTML assignment(s)
findings.detail: Direct innerHTML/outerHTML assignment is a common XSS vector if user-controlled data flows in.
findings.suggestion: Use textContent for plain text, or a trusted sanitizer (DOMPurify) for HTML output.

findings.title: Large script file (786 lines)
findings.detail: This file has 786 lines. Oversized scripts are harder to test and maintain.

findings.title: Large CSS file (331 lines)
findings.detail: This CSS file has 331 lines. Large CSS files are harder to maintain and can slow initial render.
findings.suggestion: Split into smaller component-scoped CSS files.

findings.title: Excessive !important usage (6 times)
findings.detail: Found 6 !important declarations. Overuse breaks cascade predictability and makes debugging harder.
findings.suggestion: Refactor specificity via proper cascade instead of !important overrides.

findings.title: Repeated hardcoded pixel values (e.g. 1px used 40×)
findings.detail: Repeated hardcoded pixel values indicate missing CSS custom properties (design tokens).
findings.suggestion: Extract repeated values into CSS custom properties (--spacing-md: 16px) and reference them.
